selection: TeraTools paper MS benchmark, Nate Brown 95/5 split: the 5 percent held out as patterns (8 genomes, each followed by its reverse complement); uppercase; split every record at each run of characters other than A, C, G and T, which are dropped; empty pieces dropped; records renamed q0, q1, ... in source order (map.tsv gives each source record and 0-based half-open range); then every record cut into consecutive pieces of at most 100000 bases, renamed q0, q1, ... in order (map.tsv gives each source record and 0-based half-open range)
truth: truth of mtb152-heldout16-v1 (manifest 7067e66ff388) clamped per piece: min(MS[i], end - i)
